summary: The proposed universal bound on E_Z ||rho_{Y|Z}||_infinity^(2/3) for three large spectral coordinates conditioned on all remaining spectral coordinates is false. For three independent m-coordinate unit cubes, with each Y_g the normalized block sum and Z_g its orthogonal complement, the exact conditional moment equals [Gamma(4/3)m^(2/3)Gamma(m)/Gamma(m+1/3)]^3 and is at least e^(-3)m. Embedding with A_m=diag((1/2)I+(1/2)uu^T,(1/2)I+(1/2)uu^T,(1/2)I-(3/2)uu^T) gives a full-rank target matrix with spectrum {1,1,-1,1/2,...,1/2}. This refutes only the conditional-moment proof route, not QFORM itself.
